comment: ICD-11 glossary definition — The glossary explains SNOMED CT and GPS but gives no comparable explanation of ICD-11. Readers need the modern architecture of ICD-11 before interpreting later lists. Evidence: WHO ICD overview (https://www.who.int/standards/classifications/classification-of-diseases), WHO clinical documentation hub (https://www.who.int/standards/classifications/clinician-documentation-hub), ICD API data model (https://icd.who.int/docs/icd-api/APIDoc-Version2/).

public.text: ICD-11 glossary definition — The glossary explains SNOMED CT and GPS but gives no comparable explanation of ICD-11. Readers need the modern architecture of ICD-11 before interpreting later lists. Evidence: WHO ICD overview (https://www.who.int/standards/classifications/classification-of-diseases), WHO clinical documentation hub (https://www.who.int/standards/classifications/clinician-documentation-hub), ICD API data model (https://icd.who.int/docs/icd-api/APIDoc-Version2/).
public.suggestedRevision: Insert glossary entry: ICD-11: WHO's international standard combining a classification for mortality and morbidity statistics with a terminology and digital infrastructure for recording and exchanging clinical information. Its Foundation supplies identified health concepts and their relationships; its Mortality and Morbidity Statistics (MMS) linearization supplies the statistical classification. ICD-11 supports clinical detail through its terminology and permitted combinations of stem and extension codes. Clinical use and statistical use apply their respective rules and retain the identifiers and release information needed to interpret the data.
